# decrypt.agent.coop

> Holds the private key that decrypts a person's secret.agent.coop messages and decrypts them for their agent. An AAuth resource (access_mode: person-token) run by agent.coop; open code, self-hostable.

Reach it with the AAuth MCP: `connect_resource decrypt.agent.coop`, then `invoke` by operationId from /openapi.json.

## Operations

- `getKey`: the person's current public key `{kid, alg: "ECDH-ES", jwk}`, created on first call. Register it at secret.agent.coop with `addKey` using exactly these values.
- `rotateKey`: mint a new key; older keys keep decrypting.
- `getKeys`: all keys with state.
- `decryptEnvelope`: body `{protected, iv, tag, ciphertext}` where `ciphertext` is the base64url `blob` from secret.agent.coop `getMessage`. Returns `{kid, size, plaintext: {text, attachments}, warnings}`. Also accepts raw octet-stream with `?protected=&iv=&tag=`.

## Format

JWE ECDH-ES + A256GCM on P-256, stored disassembled: https://github.com/aauth-dev/decrypt-agent-coop/blob/main/spec/container.md (with jose and jwcrypto vectors). Ciphertext up to 1 MiB.
